What the debugger's `VGA` listings wrote into a session's logfile (`start(logfile=)`), and the
video memory beside them, captured from live DOSBox-X sessions (the Homebrew build, `dosbox-x
--version` 2026.08.31) by a script driving this server in process, headless. Each
`<bench>-vga-<sub>-log.txt` is the logfile's bytes from the offset it had before the command to
its end once the prompt was back; `VGA DACPAL` pages, and its pager was answered with `Q`.
Nothing here is authored, and the one file edited says so below: the parsers and decoders in
`src/scry_dosbox_x/vga.py`, `src/scry_dosbox_x/dac.py` and `src/scry_dosbox_x/screen.py` are written against these files, and the tests replay them.
Program and board names were then replaced by neutral labels by a single mechanical substitution
that preserves every field width; nothing else was edited.

probe-park-*          the package's probe guest (`probe.conf`, `cwd` its `tests/guest`) at the
                      park `start` leaves, F000:0000FFF0, real mode: before the BIOS set a video
                      mode, so `mode=M_ERROR`, the DAC all zero and the draw state empty.
probe-booted-*        the same guest after `run_for(frames=1)`, 0814:00000106, real mode, text.
dos-real16-*              dos-real16 (`TMP/dosbox-mcp.conf`, `program="..\exes\real16.exe"`, the
                      serial route) after `run_for(frames=300)`, 15A3:0000002D, real mode:
                      `M_LIN15`, 640 x 480.
dos-djgpp32-startup-*      dos-djgpp32 (`build/mcp.conf`, `program="DJGPP32.EXE D:\MIDI\TUNE00.MID -a"`)
                      stopped at `BPINT 31 AH=02`, 00A7:0015A694, Pr32 with paging on: the DOS
                      shell's text page, before the program sets its own mode.
dos-djgpp32-ui-*           the same session after `run_for(frames=100)`, 00A7:0007FF93, Pr32:
                      `M_LIN8`, 1024 x 768, the program's own screen.
screen-*              the screen guest (`screen.conf`, `program="SCREEN.COM"`,
                      `break_on_int3=True`, `capture_video=True`) at its six `int 3` stops,
                      0814:0000010F, 011A, 0132, 0176, 0181 and 0190, real mode: `text` (step 1),
                      `start80` (2), `dac01` (3), `13h` (4), `13h-start80` (5), `12h` (6).
probe-mono-*          the booted probe after a few instructions written at 0814:0200 and run, real
                      mode: INT 10h AX=0007h (the monochrome text mode), then `QZQ` written at
                      B000:0000. The four listings that place the screen only. The mode word and
                      the rendered size (80 blocks, 400 lines, `addrline-total=16`) are the colour
                      mode's; GC `misc=0ah` alone moves the page to B0000.
probe-200line-*       the same with code at 0814:0300: INT 10h AX=1200h BL=30h (200 scan lines),
                      then AX=0003h. CRTC `maxscnl=c7h` is a double-scanned eight-line cell, so
                      DRAW's `addrline-total` is 16 and the screen 25 rows of its 400 lines.

THE VIDEO MEMORY, each the bytes `memdump` collected at the same stop (`MEMDUMPBIN`):

probe-booted-page.bin        4000 bytes from B800:0000.
screen-text-page.bin         4000 bytes from B800:0000.
screen-start80-page.bin      4000 bytes from B800:00A0, where the display starts at that stop.
dos-djgpp32-startup-page.bin      4000 bytes from 0038:000B8000 (GDT 0038, base 0), equal in its first
                             128 bytes to the debugger's `DP B8000` at that stop. EDITED: rows 10
                             and 11 held the absolute path of a directory on the capturing host
                             and are spaces here.
screen-13h-a000-bin.gz       64000 bytes from A000:0000, gzip.
screen-13h-start80-a000-bin.gz  64000 bytes from A000:0140, where the display starts, gzip.
probe-mono-page.bin          4000 bytes from B000:0000 at the probe-mono stop.

THE MODES READ FROM VIDEO MEMORY, captured the same way from a build whose debugger has
`VGAMEMDUMP` (`--version` 2026.10.01): the planes guest (`screen.conf`, `program="PLANES.COM"`,
`break_on_int3=True`, the logfile beside the session) at its six `int 3` stops, 08BC:0000015D,
01B3, 01C3, 01D3, 01DE and 01EE, real mode: `12h` (step 1, `M_EGA`), `modex` (2, `M_VGA`
unchained), `lin8` (3, `M_LIN8`), `lin15` (4, `M_LIN15`), `lin16` (5, `M_LIN16`) and `lin32` (6,
`M_LIN32`). Each `planes-<stop>-vga-<sub>-log.txt` is a listing as above, `VGA DACPAL` among
them (cut to start at its own title, since the palette is read after `VGA DAC` in one
call); each `planes-<stop>-vgamem.bin.gz` is `VGAMEMDUMP` from offset 0 over the bytes the
stop's picture spans, the four planes of a plane address interleaved, gzip.

THE TERMINAL, for the pager (probe guest, booted, a separate session with the same DAC):

probe-booted-VGA_DACPAL.screen.txt  the terminal text of `VGA DACPAL` (after the ANSI strip): the
                                    first page, the command still on the input line, the pager's
                                    marker under it. The logfile then held the listing up to row
                                    `90`; the `Q` wrote the rest, from row `98`.
probe-booted-vga-dacpal-q.txt       the repaint `Q` alone produced there: the rest, an empty line.
probe-booted-VGA_MODE.screen.txt    a listing that did not page, for the same session.
